title: Bound generated blog slugs after truncation, never publish an invalid URL
root_cause: Existing Edge slugify normalizes and trims separators before slicing to 70 characters. A hyphen exactly at the truncation boundary remains trailing and is rejected downstream as INVALID_SLUG.
impact: 2026-10-23 approved daily blog artifact is GENERATED but cannot enter the protected repository blog publishing flow; it has not been published.
fix: Keep original 70-character limit and normalized slug but strip a trailing hyphen after truncation; never relax Python publication slug validator or alter approved article text.
prevention_rule: After normalization and length capping every generated public slug must match [a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*; test real boundary, long titles, accented inputs and path safety.
release_gates: Exact-head protected Required CI and CodeQL
Supabase provider-preview and production Edge source parity readback
Same daily blog publisher obligation, unique URL/content ID and protected merge
Public Netlify canonical article readback before LIVE_PROVEN
Do not create/replay provider publication when external ID exists
